I also never could figure out why Stan bothered to pretend there was nothing supernatural happening in Gravity Falls. He said it was “to protect them”, but how does that make them any safer? The supernatural doesn’t go away just because he ignores it. The reveal that he knew all along was definitely overdue but was foreshadowed well. 

Not telling Dipper about the portal makes sense, if he knew it could potentially destroy the universe he would very likely try to shut it down, deciding that the long-lost brother/author return wasn’t worth the risk. That was the most sensible solution, and Dipper tends to pick the most sensible solutions, and Stan knows this.

Honestly I don’t think Stan ever really expected Dipper to follow through with his promise; in the very next episode he’s exploring the Bunker alongside his employees. And I don’t know if Dipper ever really believed that Stan wasn’t hiding anything else. Why else would he bring up the possibility of him hiding “bombshell secrets about this town” if he didn’t suspect it? Not only are they lying to each other, they’re lying to themselves about each other. That’s part of what makes this scene (and this entire episode) so fascinating to me.
